info.title: Delta Registry — Regione Lombardia Open Grants & Tenders Registry Delta Monitor
info.description: Delta monitor for Regione Lombardia's Socrata open-data grants/tenders registry (bandi). Computes a real OPEN/UPCOMING/CLOSED status from source dates, classifies each bando into a policy-area taxonomy, and emits NEW_LISTING/STATUS_CHANGE/UPDATED events. Pay-per-event: billed only for what changed.

post.summary: Delta monitor for Regione Lombardia's Socrata open-data grants/tenders registry (bandi). Computes a real OPEN/UPCOMING/CLOSED status from source dates, classifies each bando into a policy-area taxonomy, and emits NEW_LISTING/STATUS_CHANGE/UPDATED events. Pay-per-event: billed only for what changed.
post.x-sync-pattern-reason: Real observed max runtime 9.1s fits safely under GPT Actions' 45s cap — run-sync-get-dataset-items is safe to expose directly.

onlyNew.description: When true (default), only NEW_LISTING, STATUS_CHANGE and UPDATED events are delivered - never a BASELINE_SNAPSHOT or SNAPSHOT_NO_DIFF row. When false, every bando currently in scope is delivered every run, including the free first-run baseline and unchanged rows - useful to preview the full dataset before committing spend.

eventTypes.description: Restricts which of the three charged event types are delivered. Leave empty to deliver all three. Has no effect on BASELINE_SNAPSHOT/SNAPSHOT_NO_DIFF, which are controlled solely by onlyNew.

statusFilter.description: Deliver only bandi whose computed status (derived by this Actor from apertura_adesione/chiusura_adesione against the run's own clock - the source itself publishes no lifecycle-status column) is one of these. This is a delivery-time filter only - every bando is still tracked internally regardless, so one that transitions into or out of your filtered status is still correctly reported as STATUS_CHANGE the moment it does. Leave empty to deliver all statuses.

policyAreaFilter.description: Deliver only bandi classified into one of these policy areas by this Actor's own taxonomy mapper (built from the real, observed direzione_generale values in the live dataset - a free-text field with no controlled vocabulary in the source itself). Delivery-time only, same tracking guarantee as statusFilter. Leave empty for all areas. See README for the full taxonomy and its source mapping.

keyword.description: Full-text search passed server-side as Socrata's own $q parameter, matched against every text column (titolo_bando, direzione_generale, ente, tipo_strumento). Example: "formazione" or "ICT". Leave empty to skip.

directorateFilter.description: Deliver only bandi whose direzione_generale case-insensitively contains one of these values. Free-text matching against whatever Regione Lombardia's own back office typed in, not a stable enum - real values observed live include "ISTRUZIONE, FORMAZIONE, LAVORO", "CULTURA", "ARIA SPA". Delivery-time only. Leave empty for all directorates.

maxItems.description: Stops the run once this many records have been pushed (and charged, where applicable). Records not yet reached when the limit is hit are simply re-evaluated fresh next run. Leave unset for no limit - the full register is only ~1,912 rows, so an unlimited run is inexpensive even on a full onlyNew:false baseline pass.

deltaStateName.description: Names the persistent Key-Value Store this run's delta memory lives in. Use a distinct name per independent schedule/filter configuration so they don't share baseline progress.

resetState.description: When true, ignores all previously-remembered bandi for this deltaStateName and re-baselines from scratch (every bando becomes a fresh, uncharged BASELINE_SNAPSHOT again, subject to onlyNew).

socrataAppToken.description: An optional Socrata app token (free, self-service at dati.lombardia.it) sent as the X-App-Token header on every request. Unauthenticated requests share a per-IP throttle Socrata does not fully document publicly. Supplying your own token removes the shared-IP ceiling entirely. Never logged or persisted beyond this run.

requestTimeoutSecs.description: Aborts a single Socrata API request that takes longer than this, so one slow response never stalls the whole run.

maxRetries.description: Retry attempts (exponential backoff with jitter) before a single page fetch is given up on as failed. Applies only to retryable outcomes (429 and 5xx responses, or a request timeout) - any other non-2xx response is treated as final immediately.

200.description: Array of normalized records from the actor run.

fields.title: Regione Lombardia Open Grants & Tenders Registry Delta Monitor record

record_id.description: codice_bando - the source's own stable identity key for this bando.

event_id.description: sha256(record_id|event_type|status_fingerprint|content_fingerprint), excluding scraped_at, so a retried delivery reproduces the identical id.

event_type.description: BASELINE_SNAPSHOT: first-ever check (free). NEW_LISTING: a codice_bando not previously seen, after baseline. STATUS_CHANGE: computed_status (UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED) differs from last check. UPDATED: any other tracked field changed with status unchanged. SNAPSHOT_NO_DIFF: nothing differed (free, only when onlyNew=false).

scraped_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this row was actually fetched.

is_new.description: True only for this bando's first-ever record (event_type=BASELINE_SNAPSHOT).

source_url.description: The Socrata API query URL used to fetch this exact row.

direzione_generale.description: Free-text publishing directorate/entity as typed by Regione Lombardia's own back office - no controlled vocabulary in the source.

presentato.description: Number of applications submitted so far. Normalized to a real number - the live Socrata API serializes this as a JSON string, not a number, despite the field's own declared type.

computed_status.description: Computed by this Actor from apertura_adesione/chiusura_adesione against the run's own clock - the source itself publishes no lifecycle-status column. A null chiusura_adesione is treated as open-ended (never CLOSED on that basis alone).

policy_area.description: This Actor's own taxonomy classification of direzione_generale, built from the real distribution of values observed in the live dataset. See README for the full mapping. UNCLASSIFIED for any value not yet seen/mapped.

changed_fields.description: Present only on STATUS_CHANGE/UPDATED events - each entry names one field with its real previous and current value.

status_fingerprint.description: sha256(computed_status) - drives STATUS_CHANGE classification, the highest-priority transition.

content_fingerprint.description: sha256 over every other tracked field - drives UPDATED classification when status_fingerprint is unchanged.

license.description: License framing for this dataset. Stated with an explicit confirmation caveat - see README.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per delta event, most recent first.
